examples.scenario: Brand voice development for B2B fintech startup

input.company: Ledgr — automated financial reporting for CFOs
input.audience: CFOs and finance directors at mid-market companies ($10M-$200M revenue)
input.competitor_voice_to_avoid: Bland enterprise SaaS speak (Sage, Quickbooks) — corporate, safe, boring

voice_dna.one_sentence: We know more about financial reporting than most, and we share that knowledge freely — without talking down.
we_do: Use finance terminology correctly and confidently
Explain complex concepts plainly when needed
Acknowledge when something is genuinely hard
we_dont: Oversimplify to the point of being condescending
voice_dna.on_brand_example: Month-end close takes most finance teams 5-8 business days. It doesn't have to. Here's why it takes that long — and what changes when you remove the manual steps.
voice_dna.off_brand_example: Leverage our cutting-edge, AI-powered financial automation solution to synergistically optimize your close process and drive stakeholder value.

voice_dna.one_sentence: We say what we mean. We don't soften everything into corporate mush, but we're not unnecessarily harsh.
we_do: Lead with the conclusion, then explain
we_dont: Use passive voice to avoid ownership
voice_dna.on_brand_example: Your close process is slow because you're reconciling in spreadsheets. We fix that.
voice_dna.off_brand_example: In order to potentially address the challenges that may be associated with the month-end close process, our solution offers a range of capabilities that could be beneficial.

formal_to_conversational.description: Professional but human — like a smart colleague, not a legal document

reserved_to_expressive.description: Measured. We let the data do the emoting.

serious_to_playful.description: Finance is serious. We can be wry but never glib.

abstract_to_concrete.description: Always specific. Always numbers. Always examples.

we_to_you.description: Reader-first. Their problem, their outcome, their time.

top_5_rules: Lead with the answer, then explain
Use specific numbers, not ranges or approximations
Write 'you close faster' not 'the close process becomes more efficient'
Never use passive voice when active voice is possible
If you can cut a word without losing meaning, cut it
on_brand_examples: Month-end close in 2 days. Not a promise — a result 340 CFOs have measured.
We don't do enterprise contracts. Month-to-month, full access, cancel any time.
Your auditors will see the same data you see, in real time. No more prep work before audits.
